entities.name: Developer / maintainer
entities.responsibility: Explores an unfamiliar codebase from system context to source evidence.

entities.name: Okie
entities.responsibility: Evidence-backed architecture atlas with semantic zoom and deterministic guided stories.

entities.name: Source repository
entities.responsibility: Supplies source references used to support architecture claims.

entities.name: Browser graphics platform
entities.responsibility: Provides the canvas, WebAssembly runtime, and WebGPU or WebGL2 surface used to render the atlas.

entities.name: Atlas web app
entities.responsibility: Owns the browser shell, navigation, inspection, search, camera controls, and guided-story experience.

entities.name: Architecture model
entities.responsibility: Defines versioned architecture claims, evidence, views, hierarchy, zoom policy, and story state.

entities.name: Scene compiler
entities.responsibility: Deterministically converts semantic architecture and stories into renderer scenes, patches, and timelines.

entities.name: Rust / WASM renderer
entities.responsibility: Validates, culls, hit-tests, animates, and draws scene-protocol objects through GPU-backed browser rendering.

entities.name: Build and fixture tooling
entities.responsibility: Builds the WASM package and generates deterministic demo and stress fixtures.

entities.name: Application shell
entities.responsibility: Composes the canvas, level rail, search, inspector, diagnostics, and story controls.

entities.name: Navigation and history
entities.responsibility: Canonicalizes shareable URL state and separates pushed navigation from replaced selection and camera state.

entities.name: Renderer host
entities.responsibility: Creates GPU or Canvas2D backends and forwards scene, camera, input, and visibility state.

entities.name: Guided story player
entities.responsibility: Frames story entities, interpolates camera flights, and presents deterministic focus and flow state.

entities.name: Evidence presentation
entities.responsibility: Distinguishes observed facts, deterministic inference, and AI-authored explanation.

entities.name: Semantic schema
entities.responsibility: Defines entities, relations, evidence, snapshots, views, stories, and user overrides.

entities.name: Normalized state
entities.responsibility: Stores qualified identities and indexed rows for snapshots, hierarchy, layouts, zoom bands, and stories.

entities.name: Hierarchy selectors
entities.responsibility: Reconstructs snapshots and selects a view scoped to a root entity.

entities.name: Architecture validation
entities.responsibility: Rejects invalid snapshots, views, stories, geometry, evidence, and overrides before compilation.

entities.name: Scene compilation
entities.responsibility: Maps visible semantic entities and relations to bounded renderer objects and paths.

entities.name: Story compilation
entities.responsibility: Converts narrated focus steps into deterministic camera and emphasis keyframes.

entities.name: Scoped scene and patch compilation
entities.responsibility: Selects a root-scoped view and diffs retained scenes into revisioned patches.

entities.name: TypeScript protocol mirror
entities.responsibility: Defines the TypeScript scene, patch, primitive, LOD, and timeline payloads sent to Rust.

entities.name: Versioned renderer protocol
entities.responsibility: Validates scene objects, representations, paths, patches, and timelines at the Rust boundary.

entities.name: Scene engine
entities.responsibility: Owns retained scene state, semantic LOD, visibility, camera, culling, hit testing, patches, and timeline sampling.

entities.name: GPU renderer
entities.responsibility: Builds mesh and glyph data, initializes WebGPU/WebGL2, and submits visible frame geometry.

entities.name: Browser WASM bridge
entities.responsibility: Deserializes host payloads and exposes scene, patch, camera, visibility, picking, and timeline controls to JavaScript.

entities.name: WASM build driver
entities.responsibility: Selects release, profiling, or debug wasm-pack builds and reports missing prerequisites.

entities.name: Fixture generator
entities.responsibility: Compiles the checked semantic fixture into renderer scene and timeline JSON.

entities.name: Stress scene generator
entities.responsibility: Generates seeded large scenes for renderer profiling.
